about: Elden Force's own animations, hand-keyed on Elden Ring's player skeleton (tools_scripts/anims/pose.py explains the controls), baked into jumpring/anims.bin and built into the player's own animation binders at launch (src/anims.rs). Each plays in one of the twelve event slots the player's behaviour graph has without an animation (W_Event<id>); 'cue' is the body cue it replaces (anim.rs).

twohand.about: hands cupped at the hip, then both palms thrust forward (Kamehameha, Tailed Beast Bomb)

dive.about: 0.16.0: Deku's and Luffy's skydive after a swing (tools_scripts/anims/make_dive.py): a skydiver's box position after Spider-Man's freefall, back arched, head up, elbows and knees bent, with wind flutter and a slow roll (replaces the old raise pose: Raise plays Elden Ring's own gesture)

luffy_swing.about: 0.14.1: Luffy's swing: Deku's swing body (legs trailing, sweep, lean back), his real right arm hidden from the first frame: the stretched arm the overlay draws from his shoulder is his only right arm

pistol.about: Luffy's Gum-Gum Pistol: the arm stretches out and snaps back

grizzly.about: Luffy's Gum-Gum Grizzly Magnum: both arms stretch out palms first

sweep.about: 1.2.0 (after the user's test: the hand-keyed X was rigid): Todoroki's Dancing Flame plays Elden Ring's own motion-captured sidearm throw (a000_050070, the throwing knife's): a wind-up by the head and a whipping sweep of the arm with a step; the fire fans out along it

fly.about: 0.10.0: Superman flight, fist first (Goku's and All Might's air dash) | 1.2.x (user: Goku 'loses flight animation if you fly 3x fast'): held to 6 s, so three chained flights never outlast it

air_dash.about: 0.10.0: an anime air dash: leaning hard into it, arms swept back, legs tucked

whip.about: 0.13.0: Deku's Black Whip swing, after Spider-Man: the arm flung up to the tendril, legs trailing as he drops into the arc, swept through the bottom, then leaning back with the legs leading up the far side

flying_kick.about: 1.2.0 (user: the hand-keyed air kick looked rigid; reference: JUMP FORCE Deku's Shoot Style): Elden Ring's own motion capture: Dryleaf Whirlwind's opening airborne sweeping kick (Shadow of the Erdtree, a858_040000), or without the DLC the Kick Ash of War's high front kick (a712_040000). The air hits cut it after the kick.

pitch.about: 1.2.0 (after the user's test: the hand-keyed pitch was clunky): Naruto's Rasen Shuriken plays Elden Ring's own motion-captured spear throw (a000_050170): the arm drawn back by the shoulder, then a lunging overhand throw with the whole body; the shuriken leaves his hand at the release
